definition: equal-weight replicating portfolio over each historical point-in-time CSI300 plus CSI500 eligible cross-section
return_basis: the same audited T+1 open to T+5 close constituent return used for every model; this is an executable research benchmark, not the vendor-published CSI800 total-return index
rebalance_alignment: same weekly signal date and T+1 execution calendar as each candidate
execution_policy: same buy/sell availability, failed-fill retention, 2 percent name cap and 5 percent ADV participation limit
cost_policy: gross and net paths reported; net path uses the exact frozen candidate cost implementation
incrementality_benchmark: PEERLITE_K16_MSE frozen M6 score under the exact same portfolio mapper
selection_role: CCC and Gate are screened relative to PEERLITE_K16_MSE; the CSI800 replicating path is a market reference and does not replace the frozen incremental comparator
